description: Goal-driven definitional unfold restricted to a validated allowlist. For a theorem, the gate matches the allowlisted definitions whose name appears in the goal/statement and emits a single `simp [<matched defs>]`. Fires ONLY when at least one allowlisted definition is present in the goal; otherwise no emission (so it cannot fire on Nat/arith/Multiset/List goals that name none of these defs).

actions.name: def_unfold_simp_allowlist
actions.tactic: simp [<allowlisted defs present in the goal>]
actions.lemma_or_def: dynamic: intersection(allowlist, defs named in goal)

gate.forbidden_namespaces_note: No explicit namespace forbid needed: the goal-presence gate already prevents firing on Nat / arithmetic / Multiset / List goals that name none of the allowlisted defs.

evaluation_rule: candidate_solved = literal_RC2_solved OR (gate fires AND `simp [matched defs]` closes the goal single-shot from the initial state)
